video_title: Steve Kerr insists ‘really good’ Warriors practices led to win | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr credits recent team practices for improved offensive rhythm
quotes.excerpt: we were due, it's been a tough five, six game stretch shooting the ball
quotes.quote: We had two really good practices in a row the last two days. We were just building rhythm, getting better with our recognition of what we're trying to do offensively. And then we were due, you know. It's been a tough five, six game stretch shooting the ball, but it's just a matter of time with the quality shooters we have. It always helps to build rhythm and we did that the last couple of days in practice.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr credits two really good practices for the Warriors finding their offensive rhythm again after a tough shooting stretch.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the team's recent practice sessions and their impact on offensive rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr explains the tactical value of Kevon Looney and Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: having Kevon Looney next to him kind of frees him up to to roam a little bit
quotes.quote: Kevon Looney gives us the shot blocking, paint presence and then Draymond Green, he can guard anybody, right? We can put him on Jason Tatum like we did the other night, or he can plug off of a player and play center field. We can use him in a lot of different ways, but having Kevon Looney next to him kind of frees him up to to roam a little bit and disrupt the offense.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr explains the tactical synergy between Kevon Looney and Draymond Green, noting that Looney allows Draymond to roam and disrupt opposing offenses.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains the defensive roles and tactical utility of Kevon Looney and Draymond Green.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr discusses Draymond Green's evolution as a playmaker and shooter
quotes.excerpt: he's now he's taking four or five threes a game next to Kevon Looney
quotes.quote: We've been growing offensively since the trip. We've tweaked a few things, and that lineup change obviously changes some things as well. But Draymond Green has always been a great passer and a point forward. I just feel like he's in a great place. He's doing such a great job leading our team, showing patience offensively. And now he's taking four or five threes a game next to Kevon Looney, and so he's in a good spot here the last couple games.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says Draymond Green is in a great place and highlights his increased aggression from behind the arc, noting he is now taking four or five threes a game.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses offensive adjustments and Draymond Green's performance following a recent lineup change.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the impact of Brandon Podziemski's return
quotes.excerpt: he just gives us that element of speed that can break down the defense
quotes.quote: We really missed Brandon Podziemski while he was out. He just gives us that element of speed that can break down the defense. You're not calling any plays, you just get a stop and you throw him the ball and he's just gone. Just incredible speed and the ability to get to the rim and score and break the defense down. That was a big key tonight as well.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the Warriors really missed the speed of Brandon Podziemski while he was out, calling his ability to break down the defense a big key to their success.

structured.context: Steve Kerr comments on the impact of Brandon Podziemski returning to the lineup after being out.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr praises Moses Moody's shooting performance
quotes.excerpt: his high school buddy Moses Moody played a great game too
quotes.quote: His high school buddy Moses Moody played a great game too. All those threes, he was due. Moses Moody hasn't shot it well the last few games, so you kind of knew that it was time. Watching those two guys out there is really fun.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr praises Moses Moody for his shooting performance, saying he was due for a big game after struggling in recent outings.

structured.context: Steve Kerr praises Moses Moody for his shooting performance in the recent game.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr discusses George Niang's physicality and nickname
quotes.excerpt: one of the great nicknames in sports in my opinion
quotes.quote: One of the great nicknames in sports in my opinion. I've always loved George Niang. We had him here nine years ago in our G League program and he's always been one of my favorite players as an opponent. Just watching his brain at work, he's really, really smart and he's physical and he's competitive and he's really skilled, great three-point shooter, great passer. He fits in really well with our group and he's also an unbelievable presence in the locker room.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr calls Georges Niang one of his favorite players and says he has one of the great nicknames in sports.

structured.context: Steve Kerr shares his appreciation for Georges Niang's skills and personality.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green's adjustment to aging
quotes.excerpt: it's particularly hard when you've been a great player as Draymond Green has
quotes.quote: It's not easy for any player when they get older, but it's particularly hard when you've been a great player as Draymond Green has. He's a Hall of Fame player, first ballot Hall of Famer. You get older and you have to adapt and you have to reimagine yourself. That's not an easy thing to do, especially for somebody as competitive and passionate as Draymond Green. I think he's really finding his way. He's understanding that he can still lead in a really productive manner even through some of his frustrations, and that's exactly what he's done.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green adapting as he gets older: It is not easy to reimagine yourself as a Hall of Fame player, but he is finding his way and leading in a productive manner.

structured.context: Steve Kerr reflects on how Draymond Green is adapting his game as he gets older.
